r0.why: Woody perennial, four groups, naked-seed etymology, ovules, no ovary, scales/leaves/cones or alone in yew and Ginkgo all from [1]-[4].

r1.why: Over 1,000 species [15], conifers largest with 600-630 [12][25], cycads palm-like ~338 mostly tropical near equator [28][29], gnetophytes 95-100 incl. horizontal Welwitschia [30][31], single Ginkgo tall bilobed [12][30][31].

r2.why: All perennial woody [22], fewer niches, Parasitaxus parasite, Retrophyllum aquatic [24], 65% dioecious vs conifers monoecious [13], all conifers wind-pollinated [27].

r3.why: Sporophyte-dominant like vascular plants [37], reduced dependent short-lived gametophyte [5][37], micro/megaspores in pollen/ovulate cones [38], pollen to sperm [42], megaspore development retained in ovule [43], pollination [45].

r4.why: Progymnosperms late Devonian 383 Mya [18], Late vs Early Carboniferous origin [16], radiation after genome duplication ~319 Mya [17]; hedged wording kept.

r5.why: Suggested scorpionfly pollination with proboscides on pollination drops [19], likely mutualism before independent nectar-insect coevolution [20], kalligrammatid lacewings [21].
